scene dreamsequence1
I’ve been having this recurring dream lately, but I’m not sure what it means.
lines.zh: 最近我一直在做同一个反复出现的梦，但我不确定它意味着什么。

lines.en: When I open my eyes (Though, I’m not actually opening my eyes) there are clocks, some water, and a bed.
lines.zh: 当我睁开眼睛时（虽说，我其实并没有真的睁开眼睛），眼前有一些钟、一些水，还有一张床。

lines.en: It’s the same bed I fell asleep in. Which I think implies that I’m staring at where I’m supposed to be. Which then implies that this vast ocean is my bedroom.
lines.zh: 那是我睡着时躺的那张床。我想这意味着，我正盯着自己本该在的地方。而这又意味着，这片汪洋就是我的卧室。

lines.en: And I think that is inaccurate.
lines.zh: 而我觉得这并不准确。

lines.en: I think there’s something more to this.
lines.zh: 我觉得这背后还有别的东西。

lines.en: But when you’re caught inside a dream, there isn’t much you can do to actually {i}investigate,{/i} you know?
lines.zh: 但当你被困在梦里的时候，其实也没什么办法真的去{i}调查{/i}，你懂吧？

lines.en: You need to wait until you’re awake for that.
lines.zh: 这种事得等到你醒过来才行。

lines.en: But I haven’t enjoyed being awake lately.
lines.zh: 但最近我一点也不享受醒着的状态。

lines.en: In fact, I haven’t really {i}ever{/i} enjoyed that, thinking back on all of those nights beside the rocking chair and the mice who would take bites out of my ears in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: 事实上，回想那些守在摇椅旁的夜晚，还有半夜会来咬我耳朵的老鼠，我{i}从来{/i}就没真正享受过清醒。

lines.en: Now, even when I open my eyes, it’s like they’re stitched shut. Like I’ve blocked out the world to protect myself, and...maybe that’s for the best?
lines.zh: 而现在，就算我睁开眼睛，也像被人缝上了一样。就好像我把整个世界都屏蔽在外，好保护我自己，而且……也许这样才是最好的？

lines.en: I mean, I have nothing now.
lines.zh: 我是说，我现在一无所有。

lines.en: Well...on second thought, that isn’t true.
lines.zh: 嗯……再想想，其实也不是这样。

lines.en: There are plenty of things I have. I’m just reluctant to name them during situations like this because it feels more like I’ve stolen them. That they were never mine to begin with.
lines.zh: 我拥有的东西其实很多。只是在这种时候我不太愿意一一说出它们的名字，因为那感觉更像是偷来的。好像它们从一开始就不属于我。

lines.en: scene dreamsequence2
If I wait long enough, I get a chance to see her.
lines.zh: 只要我等得够久，就有机会见到她。

lines.en: It’s an incomplete her, but it’s her nonetheless.
lines.zh: 她并不完整，但终究还是她。

lines.en: She doesn’t speak much. But when she does, she warns me that there’s someone outside wearing her skin.
lines.zh: 她话不多。可一开口，就警告我说，外面有人穿着她的皮。

lines.en: I tell her she’s silly because her skin still covers her bones. Then, the two of us kiss and spend the rest of the night covering each other in our respective bodily fluids.
lines.zh: 我笑她傻，因为她的皮还好好地裹在骨头上呢。然后我们接吻，用剩下的整夜，把彼此涂满各自的体液。

lines.en: I love being asleep now. And I love this recurring dream that has replaced the nightmares.
lines.zh: 我现在爱上了睡着的感觉。也爱上了这个取代了噩梦的、反复出现的梦。

lines.en: But there’s something I don’t love about it — and no, it’s not the fact that I know it isn’t real.
lines.zh: 但它有一点我不喜欢——不，不是因为我知道这不是真的。

lines.en: It’s the fact that it always changes when I least want it to.
lines.zh: 而是它总在我最不希望它改变的时候发生变化。

lines.en: scene dreamsequence3

There are other versions of her that come and interrupt us. And I think it’s supposed to be some sort of metaphor about how difficult it is to figure out who the {i}real{/i} her is, but I could be misunderstanding.
lines.zh: 还有别的版本的她会跑来打断我们。我想这大概是某种隐喻，说的是要弄清楚{i}真正的{/i}她是多么困难，不过也可能是我理解错了。

lines.en: For all I know, I’ve been spraying my fluids on the wrong person this whole time. And for all she knows, she could be doing the same.
lines.zh: 说不定我从头到尾都把体液喷在了错的人身上。而她也说不定一直在做着同样的事。

lines.en: Or, alternatively, all three of them could be fake and they’re all just here to lure me under the covers for a special reward.
lines.zh: 或者换一种可能，她们三个全都是假的，来这儿只是为了把我诱进被窝，好领一份特别的奖赏。

lines.en: I don’t really care, to be honest.
lines.zh: 说实话，我真的不在乎。

lines.en: She can have whatever she wants from me so long as it peels a layer or two off the pixel coating I have grown to abhor.
lines.zh: 她想要从我这里拿走什么都可以，只要那能从我已经厌恶至极的像素涂层上剥下一两层来。

lines.en: That coating causes pieces of reality to get lodged in my teeth when we’re making out sometimes, and I don’t even want to {i}start{/i} talking about how long they take to get out.
lines.zh: 那层涂层会让我们亲热的时候，有些现实的碎屑卡进我的牙缝里，而我简直{i}连开口{/i}都不想提，把它们弄出来要花多久。

lines.en: But I’m going to have to.
lines.zh: 但我终究还是得提。

lines.en: Because
lines.zh: 因为

lines.en: As always
lines.zh: 一如既往

lines.en: Things change
lines.zh: 事情会变

lines.en: scene dreamsequence4
: Akira.
lines.zh: : Akira。

lines.en: : You know I’m happier here, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我在这里更开心，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Do you know it’s because I don’t have to be around you anymore?
lines.zh: : 你知道那是因为我不用再待在你身边了吗？

lines.en: : You can’t abuse me in here. And that’s all you ever did, Akira.
lines.zh: : 在这里你没法虐待我。而你从来就只会做这一件事，Akira。

lines.en: : Ami is right for keeping you locked away. She’s right for making sure you stay dormant in bed so you can’t ruin anyone’s life the way you ruined mine.
lines.zh: : Ami 把你锁起来是对的。她让你一直瘫在床上沉睡也是对的，这样你就没法像毁掉我的人生那样去毁掉别人的人生。

lines.en: : I could have been amazing without you, you know? I could have done anything.
lines.zh: : 没有你，我本来可以很出色的，你知道吗？我什么都能做到。

lines.en: : I could have found someone my age...grown up alongside them. Gotten married. Had kids. You know, the whole nine yards.
lines.zh: : 我本来可以找个年纪相仿的人……和他一起长大。结婚。生孩子。你知道的，该有的全都有。

lines.en: : But instead, all I got was a grown man addicted to the most bitter fruit of all.
lines.zh: : 可到头来，我得到的只有一个沉溺于最苦涩的果实里无法自拔的成年男人。

lines.en: : Tell me, was the taste worth it in the end? Was I all you wanted me to be and more?
lines.zh: : 告诉我，到最后那味道值得吗？我是不是完全成了你想要的模样，甚至犹有过之？

lines.en: : Because for me, you were nothing.
lines.zh: : 因为对我来说，你什么都不是。

lines.en: : And you can have my body so long as we’re in here, but you will never have my heart.
lines.zh: : 只要我们还在里面，你可以拥有我的身体，但你永远别想拥有我的心。

lines.en: : You’re talkative today.
lines.zh: : 你今天话挺多。

lines.en: : You brought company. I’m just trying to make a good first impression.
lines.zh: : 你带了客人来。我只是想留个好印象。

lines.en: She doesn’t speak much. But when she does, she’s hurtful.
lines.zh: 她话不多。可一开口，就很伤人。

lines.en: She tells me the truth. And she does it in a way that makes me fall even harder. But no matter how hard I fall in here, I never get hurt.
lines.zh: 她说的是实话。而且是用一种让我陷得更深的方式说出来。但不管我在这里陷得多深，我从来不会受伤。

lines.en: I’ve drowned a few times. And I’ve watched the clocks fade from my sight as the current pulled me back to Kumon-mi. But it has never {i}hurt.{/i}
lines.zh: 我溺死过几次。我也看着那些钟从视线里淡去，任水流把我拉回 Kumon-mi。但那从来{i}不痛{/i}。

lines.en: And that’s sad.
lines.zh: 而这很悲哀。

lines.en: Because I think I want it to.
lines.zh: 因为我觉得我是想要它痛的。

lines.en: But I know it’s for the best as I’ll see her again tomorrow, when all her pieces are sewn back together and all of mine are a little bit more rotten.
lines.zh: 但我知道这样最好，因为明天我还会再见到她，那时她的碎片会被重新缝合，而我的碎片又会再腐烂一点。

lines.en: : She’ll let you do it raw. And she doesn’t mind if it goes into the wrong hole every now and then. Avoiding her just because she has my eyes won’t do you any good.
lines.zh: : 她会让你不戴套的。就算偶尔进错洞她也不介意。就因为她长着我的眼睛就躲着她，对你一点好处也没有。

lines.en: : Plus, if there’s anything I know about the me who isn’t me, it’s that I am but I’m not pretty much always really probably horny maybe. You know?
lines.zh: : 再说，如果我对那个「不是我的我」还算有点了解的话，那就是：我是，可我又不是，大概、也许、基本上、真的、总是很想要吧。你懂吧？

lines.en: : No.

lines.en: scene dreamsequence11
I push the angels aside and watch as I penetrate her, desperately attempting to recall what her insides felt like as I pierced through them with an unreasonable amount of force.
lines.zh: 我把天使们推开，看着自己进入她，拼命想要回忆起当初以不合理的力道贯穿她时，她里面是什么感觉。

lines.en: All I remember is that it felt better than anything I’ve ever experienced in my life.
lines.zh: 我只记得，那感觉比我这一生经历过的任何事都美好。

lines.en: But was it worth it like she said before?
lines.zh: 可它配得上她先前说的那句话吗？

lines.en: Not even close.
lines.zh: 差得远了。

lines.en: And I would castrate myself if it meant being able to measure my hand against hers. Or to help her tie a kimono for her very first festival. Or to teach her long division mixed with why it must be learned.
lines.zh: 只要能让我用手比一比她的手有多大，我愿意把自己阉了。或者能帮她为人生第一次祭典系上和服腰带。又或者能教她长除法，顺便告诉她为什么非学不可。

lines.en: I remember so much apart from the tickle of her labia.
lines.zh: 除了她那处带来的痒意，我什么都还记得。

lines.en: I can taste her sweat on my tongue while mine burns holes in her thighs as it drips from my brow.
lines.zh: 我能尝到她汗水的味道，而我的汗水从额头滴落，在她的大腿上烫出一个个洞。

lines.en: : Back here, buddy! Back here, guy!

lines.zh: : 说真的，你们现在能走开吗？这是我在五万多字以来头一回拥有叙事自觉，我真的不想被你们不请自来的乱入给毁了。

lines.en: scene dreamsequence12
I have always been a liar, but I have not always been good at it.
lines.zh: 我一向是个骗子，但我并不一向擅长说谎。

lines.en: The first time I was caught masturbating, I told my mother I was praying. And that, before I knew it, God had taken control of my body and acted of his own volition.
lines.zh: 我第一次被抓到自慰的时候，我跟母亲说我在祈祷。还说，我还没反应过来，上帝就已经接管了我的身体，自行其是。

lines.en: She did not believe me. She said that God would not prey upon children. So I asked her why those he chose to carry his message {i}did.{/i}
lines.zh: 她不信我。她说上帝不会捕食孩子。于是我问她，那为什么那些被他选中去传播福音的人{i}却会{/i}。

lines.en: She did not like that, and I felt the taste of soap for the very first time that night. But it would not be the last.
lines.zh: 她很不喜欢这句话，那一晚我第一次尝到了肥皂的味道。但那不是最后一次。

lines.en: Today, I am far more adept at concealing my tracks. But the fact that I can have sex with everyone I know without {i}bothering{/i} to hide them tells me they might just be invisible instead.
lines.zh: 如今我藏匿踪迹的本事高明多了。但我可以和所有认识的人上床，却{i}懒得{/i}去遮掩，这一事实告诉我，也许它们根本就是隐形的。

lines.en: Regardless, this does nothing for my psyche or the sack of meat I’ve been reduced to these last few nights- or however long it’s been.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，这对我的精神毫无帮助，对我这几夜——或者不管多久——沦落成的一袋肉也毫无帮助。

lines.en: It does nothing to make me want to go home.
lines.zh: 它一点也没让我想回家。

lines.en: And I will remain content in this realm, near my bugs and my bed, for as long as this body will last.
lines.zh: 只要这副身体还撑得住，我就会继续待在这个国度里，守着我的虫子和我的床，心满意足。

lines.en: Let it be known.

lines.en: Let it be gospel.

lines.en: I should hear the angel out before it chops off my hands.

lines.en: : For what reason did your sorrows craft this realm? And what may I do to mend your broken heart?
lines.zh: : 你的悲伤是出于什么理由造出了这个国度？我又能做些什么，来修补你破碎的心？

lines.zh: : 是啊，当然做不到。

lines.en: : You “divine beings” are all the same. You’re all talk until we actually {i}need{/i} something. Then, once we do, you act completely powerless and abandon us.
lines.zh: : 你们这些「神明」都是一个德性。嘴上说得好听，等我们真的{i}需要{/i}什么的时候，你们就装出一副无能为力的样子，然后抛弃我们。

lines.en: : You’re misunderstanding, Akira. I am not abandoning you. It’s just that your request is impossible.
lines.zh: : 你误会了，Akira。我并没有抛弃你。只是你的要求是不可能的。

lines.en: : Then I guess there’s a limit to your power after all, isn’t there?
lines.zh: : 那么看来你的力量到底还是有极限的，不是吗？

lines.en: : I suppose so... But still, I can feel your pain as if it is my own. And in feeling it, I can see you’ll be crushed if you remain this way.
lines.zh: : 也许吧……但尽管如此，我能感受到你的痛苦，就像是我自己的一样。而在这感受之中，我看得出来，你再这样下去会被压垮的。

lines.en: : Come, Akira. Embrace me. Cry into my bosom and I will absorb some of those feelings, so that {i}you{/i} may continue living the life that you are meant to lead.
lines.zh: : 来吧，Akira。拥抱我。在我怀里哭泣，我会吸收掉其中一部分情感，好让{i}你{/i}能继续过你本该过的生活。

lines.en: : And if I refuse?
lines.zh: : 如果我拒绝呢？

lines.en: : I will chop your body into string and make a puppet of your flesh that can see the world as you did. Feel the things {i}you{/i} felt.
lines.zh: : 我会把你的身体剁成细丝，用你的血肉做成一个傀儡，让它能像你一样看这个世界。感受{i}你{/i}所感受过的一切。

lines.en: : Yet you can’t make a meat puppet of her?
lines.zh: : 那你却做不出一个她的肉身傀儡？

lines.en: : My child...
lines.zh: : 我的孩子……

lines.en: : What exactly do you think the {i}new{/i} her is?
lines.zh: : 你以为那个{i}新的{/i}她究竟是什么？

lines.en: : This ocean of your tears will drown even her reflection if your torment does not cease. But...I’m curious.
lines.zh: : 如果你的痛苦不肯停息，这片由你的泪水汇成的海洋，连她的倒影都会淹没。不过……我很好奇。

lines.en: : Why will you only cry in here?
lines.zh: : 为什么你只肯在这里哭？

lines.en: : Because no one can see me in here.
lines.zh: : 因为在这里没人看得见我。

lines.en: : {i}We{/i} can see you in here.
lines.zh: : {i}我们{/i}在这里看得见你。

lines.en: : We have {i}always{/i} seen you.
lines.zh: : 我们{i}一直{/i}都看得见你。

lines.en: : Yet, you’ve always ignored me.
lines.zh: : 可你一直对我视而不见。

lines.en: : Because you blocked us out, my child. I can not explain it any other way.
lines.zh: : 因为是你把我们挡在外面的，我的孩子。我没法用别的方式解释。

lines.en: : But now that you are willing to see us, it means you’re willing to {i}accept{/i} us. And I have come here to beseech that acceptance in exchange for absolution.
lines.zh: : 但既然你现在愿意看见我们，就意味着你愿意{i}接受{/i}我们。而我来到这里，就是恳求用这份接受来换取赦免。

lines.en: : You can absolve me of my sins?
lines.zh: : 你能赦免我的罪？

lines.en: : I can not erase the guilt your sins have caused, but I can weave you a spidersilk hammock and reserve your plot in Heaven’s Web.
lines.zh: : 我无法抹去你的罪所带来的愧疚，但我能用蛛丝为你织一张吊床，并在天网之中为你预留一块位置。

lines.en: : Heaven’s Web?
lines.zh: : 天网？

lines.en: : The domain in which I preside — where there can be no sorrow, nor escape.
lines.zh: : 我所掌管的领域——那里没有悲伤，也没有逃离。

lines.en: : It’s the perfect match for a man like you- who wishes for naught more than stasis and eternal anesthesia.
lines.zh: : 对你这样的男人来说再合适不过了——除了停滞和永恒的麻醉，你别无所求。

lines.en: : I will not force your hand if you are not ready to extend it. But I implore you...{i}wake up.{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果你还没准备好伸出手，我不会强求。但我恳求你……{i}醒过来。{/i}

lines.en: : Drag yourself out of bed or you will {i}never{/i} have the chance to live again. And my appearance before you now shows that this is something you desire.
lines.zh: : 把自己从床上拖起来，否则你{i}永远{/i}都不会再有活下去的机会。而我现在出现在你面前，正说明这是你所渴望的。

lines.en: : You’re just lost.
lines.zh: : 你只是迷失了。

lines.en: : Why can’t I just stay {i}here?{/i} I’m happy here.
lines.zh: : 我为什么不能就{i}留在这里{/i}？我在这里很开心。

lines.en: : If that were true, I would still be on the web.
lines.zh: : 若真如此，我此刻就该还待在网上了。

lines.en: : You know well that this realm is just a waiting room. That reality is through the door behind you. And you’re far too weak to open it, but {i}I{/i} can open it for you.
lines.zh: : 你心里清楚，这个国度不过是一间候诊室。现实就在你身后的那扇门后。而你太虚弱，根本打不开它，但{i}我{/i}可以替你打开。

lines.en: : I just need to hear you say the word. And if you don’t-
lines.zh: : 我只需要听你说出那个字。如果你不说——

lines.en: : Know that more of us will come.
lines.zh: : 那么你要知道，我们中还会有更多来的。

lines.en: : How many more?
lines.zh: : 还会有多少？

lines.en: : Far more than you could ever imagine.
lines.zh: : 远比你所能想象的要多。

lines.en: : What will it be, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你意下如何，Akira？

lines.en: scene dreamsequence15
: Open it.
lines.zh: : 打开吧。

lines.en: : As you wish.
lines.zh: : 如你所愿。

scene black

I make my way over to the dorms.
lines.zh: 我朝宿舍走去。

lines.en: It doesn’t look like anyone’s in the hall today.
lines.zh: 今天大厅里好像一个人也没有。

lines.en: What do I want to do?
lines.zh: 我想做什么？

lines.en: menu:
Kill myself
lines.zh: 自杀

lines.en: I’ve been here long enough.
lines.zh: 我在这儿待得够久了。

lines.en: Goodbye now.
lines.zh: 那么，永别了。

lines.en: : Wait!
lines.zh: : 等等！

lines.en: scene dreamsequence18
: If you leave now, you’ll never get to see the end of the game!
lines.zh: : 如果你现在就走了，就永远看不到这个游戏的结局了！

lines.en: : That’s right. You need to keep playing so you can bring me back one day.
lines.zh: : 没错。你得继续玩下去，这样有一天才能把我带回来。

lines.en: : And if it’s too hard right now, just try doing it the way you did in the beginning!
lines.zh: : 要是现在太难了，就试着用你最开始的方式来玩！

lines.en: : Yeah...Just...have sex with...everybody and...gain points and...stuff...
lines.zh: : 是啊……就……和所有人上床……然后攒点数……什么的……

lines.en: : Ooooh! Like an RPG! Good thinking, Sana!
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦！就像角色扮演游戏一样！想得好啊，Sana！

lines.en: : Not like an RPG, idiot. She’s talking about visual novels that use a hidden counter to determine how much affection heroines have with the protagonist.
lines.zh: : 才不是角色扮演游戏，白痴。她说的是那种用隐藏计数来决定女主角对男主角好感度有多高的视觉小说。

lines.en: : Oh, is that how it works? I’ve always wondered how games keep track of that.
lines.zh: : 哦，原来是这么运作的吗？我一直好奇游戏是怎么记录这些的。

lines.en: : It’s not always...hidden, though...Like...sometimes you know...exactly how much affection...each character has...
lines.zh: : 不过也……不总是隐藏的……比如……有时候你……确切知道每个角色的好感度是多少……

lines.en: : That’s more of a western H-game thing. And none of those are any good, so...yeah.
lines.zh: : 那更像是欧美 H 游戏的做法。而那些没一个好玩的，所以……是啊。

lines.en: : Anyway! Don’t kill yourself, Sensei! You’ve still got so much left to see!
lines.zh: : 总之！别自杀啊，Sensei！你还有那么多东西没看到呢！

lines.en: : Yeah! And, speaking from a marketing standpoint, some of it {i}has{/i} to be happy or the story won’t sell!
lines.zh: : 对啊！而且从营销的角度来说，里面{i}总得{/i}有些开心的部分，不然这故事卖不出去！

lines.en: : And...in the event that...{i}none{/i} of it’s happy-
lines.zh: : 还有……万一……{i}一点{/i}开心的都没有——

lines.en: : You can come have sex with me!
lines.zh: : 你可以来和我做爱！

lines.en: : Or me!
lines.zh: : 或者和我！
: 或者……

lines.en: : Or me...
lines.zh: : 或者我……

lines.en: : Or me. But please know that I {i}will{/i} make you buy me dinner afterwards.
lines.zh: : 或者我。不过你先搞清楚，事后我{i}一定{/i}会让你请我吃晚饭的。

lines.en: : {b}I don’t want to play this game anymore. None of it makes any sense.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}我不想再玩这个游戏了。这一切根本没有一点道理。{/b}

lines.en: : Did it ever?
lines.zh: : 它有过吗？

lines.en: : Yeah! Like, how do you know you’re not still in that room?
lines.zh: : 对啊！比如说，你怎么知道自己不是还在那个房间里？
